product.title: Key West Historic Old Town Food Tour with 5 Authentic Tastings

description.text: From local shrimp to the perfect Key lime pie, Key West dining is a food-lover’s dream, but finding authentic flavors can be a challenge in a town packed with touristy restaurants. Discover the very best bites on a gourmet tour that samples a little bit of everything, exploring Key West’s charming neighborhoods, colorful characters, and history along the way.Included tastings feature a wide range of flavors Discover eateries off the tourist trail Visit lesser-known areas for a glimpse of local life Convenient departure point in central Key West Equipment, beverages, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on the water and island scenery. Ideal for travelers basing in Key West who want a guided Florida Keys experience without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
